name: Subset Inclusion Counting
description: Instead of asking for three specific records that share exactly three workers, the task asks for a 3-element subset of workers that fully contains exactly 3 records. By framing the search target as the workers rather than the records, and using subset inclusion rather than pairwise adjacency, models that pattern-match for "finding a triangle of edges" or "intersecting neighbors of an edge" will fail to align the set-theoretic condition with their graph heuristics.
